rerecorded: E92_S09_T01 (user request 2026-11-15: a tree for every epic with at least one task, the empty state only for zero tasks): the three cases with tasks but no dependency edge were re-recorded from the current model and renamed (full-board E00 (no dependency edge: tree, E92_S09_T01); self edge only: tree (E92_S09_T01); no dependencies but progress: tree with goal (E92_S09_T01)), and one edge-free case was added (edge-free epic, two stories, every mark and a fold in column 0 (E92_S09_T01)). Every other case is unchanged. E92_S09_T02 (user decision 2026-11-15: the padlock gate follows the task's effective dependencies and a ready task, which the script found startable, always has the open gate): the two cases whose fixtures hold a ready task with an unfinished dependency (input the script never prints) were re-recorded from the current model and renamed (fold: 3 + 3 across two columns (ready gate open, E92_S09_T02); fold: groups in two stories and two columns (ready gate open, E92_S09_T02)); only the gate of those ready tasks and groups changed (locked to open). E92_S09_T04 (the goal is the epic percent board-progress.sh states in epic_progress, read unchanged): every case graph whose epic entry exists now states the epic_progress the script would print for it (stories and decomposed from the case's stories and counted tasks, tasks_done/tasks_denominator the previously recorded goal counts), and only the goal object of every recorded variant was re-recorded from the current model (it gains stories and decomposed, its fraction is percent / 100 and its percent the floor); every other key is unchanged. The two cases whose graph has no entry for their epic (unknown epic: empty; empty epic id: empty) state no epic_progress; their goal was re-recorded the same way (the zero goal, which gains stories: 0 and decomposed: 0). E92_S10_T01 (user decision 2026-11-15, the padlock rule for every task state: closed exactly when the task is not done and the script states an unsatisfied effective dependency, open otherwise; a payload without the new waiting_on key, as every case graph here, closes it only on a locked pending task): the 8 cases whose recorded gate changed were re-recorded from the current model and renamed with the suffix "(gate rule, E92_S10_T01)" (story totals, long title, one story without totals; gate and mark matrix; fold: 6 ready + 2 locked; fold: groups in two stories and two columns (ready gate open, E92_S09_T02); state order within a cell; goal: all rejected; synthetic 27-task board; synthetic wide fan, 29 tasks in one cell); only `gate` keys changed (done, in-progress, failed and rejected tasks locked to open; pending tasks whose state is locked but whose own dependencies were done, open to locked), every other key in every variant is unchanged. E92_S10_T02 (user decision 2026-11-15: no 'Goal reached' while a story of the epic has failed; board-progress.sh states failed_stories in epic_progress and the shared goalFacts reads it as failedStories): every recorded goal object of every case and variant (51 objects in all 38 cases) gains failedStories: [] after decomposed, because no case graph states failed_stories (they read as payloads of an older script, where the key is absent and the list is empty); no case was renamed, since every case changed the same way and only by that key, and every other key of every variant is unchanged (the re-recording asserted that removing the key gives back the previous recording exactly). E92_S11_T03 (user request 2026-11-15: same-state tasks fold into a group already when more than three share a story and a column; FOLD_THRESHOLD lowered from 5 to 3): exactly one case changed and was re-recorded from the current model and renamed from 'fold: 5 ready do not fold' to 'fold: 5 ready now fold (fold threshold 3, E92_S11_T03)': its five ready tasks now fold into one group of 5, so its nodes, bands, edges, foldable and layout keys and the goal's y position changed, and its unfolded variants now carry the group's collapse header; every other case is unchanged (each holds either no cell with 4 or 5 tasks of one state, or a cell that already folded at more than 5).
